content: Faith, Hope, Love, and Insight: these are the four great healing powers.
author: Carl Jung
sourceWork: Modern Man in Search of a Soul (1933)
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. Genuine love is not a transaction where you keep score of who gave what; it is a state of being where you extend warmth and goodwill without needing to control the other person.

In Carl Jung's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. The biggest barrier to deep connection is never external; it is our own fear of rejection. We build armor around our hearts to avoid pain, but that same armor ends up locking out the warmth and intimacy we crave.
reflectionPrompt: How can you create a moment of stillness today to reconnect with your deeper sense of purpose?
